grounding_gaps.reason: The Chatterbox backend executes the interface but returns dummy values. Kinetic OD600 values are benchmark-defined, not instrument observations.
Chatterbox does not model stabilization, exposure, or temperature dynamics. Logical-time stabilization is benchmark-defined.
No robot arm or physical workcell handoff is executed. Plate identity is preserved by world state across independent local fixtures.
The deterministic logistic curves are stable workflow fixtures and must not be interpreted as biological predictions.

sources.derivation: Pinned eLabFTW 5.6.10 create-patch-get request and response sequence captured from the disposable official container.
Pinned PyLabRobot 0.2.1 methods were executed locally with OpentronsOT2Simulator and Chatterbox backends.
Grounds the selected 96-well, eight-replicate, 200 uL, 30 C, OD600, two-minute, 20-hour protocol values.
Defines logical-time stabilization, synthetic OD values, fault schedules, and state-verification semantics.
